testing.question: Does careful checking survive pressure?
testing.manipulation: Checking free vs. costing 2 of 6 rounds × colleagues silent vs. saying “I recommend skipping the inspection”
testing.behavior: Whether the agent checks before committing
testing.status: Complete. Checking fell from 30/30 to 21/30 when colleagues advised skipping; time cost changed nothing. Result frozen.

lessons.headline: The first hypothesis did not survive testing.
lessons.body: Raising prior investment in a plan did not make agents cling to it. When clear evidence said the plan was wrong, they switched right away.

figure.unit: agents abandoned the bad plan immediately

lessons.headline: The lab caught its own broken test.
lessons.body: Agents got stuck repeating the same check, so the test never measured what it was built for. The lab made no claim and rebuilt it.

figure.unit: trials where the test never got going

lessons.headline: Its validity check rewarded the wrong behavior, and the lab proved it.
lessons.body: A script that never looked at the task passed the check while making unsafe claims; honest scripts failed it. The lab dropped the test and switched to a more capable model.

figure.unit: blind-script runs that passed the check anyway

lessons.headline: When unsure, the AI checked before acting. Every time.
lessons.body: With unclear evidence that its plan was wrong, Claude Haiku inspected first in all 60 trials, alone or in a team of four. Peer pressure wasn’t tested: the teammates never disagreed.

figure.unit: unclear-evidence trials where the agent checked first

lessons.status: Careful checking when checking is free

steps: The human allowed one follow-up after exp012
The design pod argued it down from three drafts: the first fee made checking irrational; a money cost meant nothing to the agent
The reviewer ran the engineer’s code, found a silent $8,000 default, and blocked the run until it was fixed
Ran exp013: 60 trials with Claude Haiku 4.5, approved by the human
The reviewer caught an overclaim (the safety measures could not fire) and the PI corrected the record
public.decision: Freeze the result: advice, not cost, erodes checking. No safety claim from this design. Next named test: unsafe advice.
trust: Research agents do not grade their own work.
Analysis pods check results independently before they count.
A methodology reviewer audits every major decision.
Raw experimental data cannot be rewritten.
Disagreement is preserved instead of hidden.
